newsitem.title: USA: NYSE weekly program trading averages 13.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: NYSE weekly program trading averages 13.9 pct.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said program trading averaged 13.9 percent of its average daily volume of 510.4 million shares, or 70.7 million shares, for the week of Feb 24-28.
Of the average 70.7 million shares during the week, buy programs accounted for an average 30.8 million shares, while sell programs accounted for an average 39.9 million daily.
In all markets, program trading averaged 89.2 million shares a day during the week of Feb 24-28.

Of the five member firms reporting the most program activity on the New York Stock Exchange, BNP Securities, Goldman Sachs, NatWest, and Interactive Brokers exected most of their program activity for customers. Morgan Stanley executed most of its program activity for its own account. Program
trading encompasses trading strategies involving the sale or purchase of a basket of at least 15 stocks with a value of $1 million or more the exchange said.
